description: This file contains utility functions for user forms in the vtiger CRM module. It includes functions for checking Asterisk server details, retrieving Asterisk extensions, and generating client-side JavaScript validation code for user form inputs.

methods.name: checkAsteriskDetails
methods.description: Checks if Asterisk server details are configured in the database, returning 'true' if configured, 'false' otherwise.

methods.name: getAsteriskExtensions
methods.description: Retrieves assigned Asterisk extensions for active users from the database.

methods.name: get_validate_record_js
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for client-side validation of user form data, including checks for required fields, email formats, and Asterisk extension conflicts.
